headline: ECB President Christine Lagarde to Step Down Early in February 2027
summary: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde will leave her post on February 7, 2027, almost nine months before her term is scheduled to end in late October.
why: Leadership transitions at major central banks can influence monetary policy direction, institutional continuity, and market sentiment regarding interest rates.

impacts.name: Eurozone
impacts.why: Leadership change at the ECB creates uncertainty regarding future monetary policy.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An early departure by the ECB president introduces leadership transition uncertainties that can influence Eurozone bond yields and currency valuations.
